desc:
Our fan-art take on the Pip-Boy 2000 from the Fallout series: the chunky wrist computer with a green CRT screen, dials, a speaker grille and a padded red cuff. A prop like this sits right in front of the first-person camera, so every surface gets looked at.

We kept the retro-industrial feel, with olive paint chipped down to the metal, hazard stripes, warning stickers, worn leather straps and a scratched glass screen. Even with all that detail it's only 8K tris on a single 2K texture set, with clean topology and pivots on the moving parts, so the screen and controls can be animated and the display can show live UI in engine.
